description: This is a Java unit test class for the PolicyId class, which tests various behaviors such as immutability, equality, exception throwing for invalid inputs, dummy status, string representation, and getter methods.

classes.name: PolicyIdTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the PolicyId class, verifying its various behaviors.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the PolicyId class is immutable and that its associated NamespacedEntityId is also immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of PolicyId work correctly using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: invalidNamespaceThrowsPolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Checks that invalid namespaces throw PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: invalidNameThrowsPolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Checks that invalid names throw PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: dummyIsDummy
methods.description: Verifies that the PolicyId returned by dummy() is considered a dummy.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedDummyIsDummy
methods.description: Verifies that manually created PolicyIds with empty or underscore name parts are considered dummy.

methods.name: validPolicyIdIsNoDummy
methods.description: Verifies that valid policy IDs are not considered dummy.

methods.name: toStringConcatenatesNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Verifies that toString() returns the expected concatenation of namespace and name.

methods.name: returnsCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Checks that getNamespace() returns the correct namespace.

methods.name: returnsCorrectName
methods.description: Checks that getName() returns the correct name.

methods.name: inNamespaceWithRandomNameHasCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Verifies that inNamespaceWithRandomName() creates a PolicyId with the correct namespace and a non-empty name.

methods.name: policyIdOfPolicyIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that calling PolicyId.of() with a PolicyId returns the same instance.
